NAAZ2 is a medical classification code used within the Danish acute surgery registry to document anesthesiological [[preoperative-optimization]] [^src1]. It was introduced to systematically monitor whether patients are being optimized prior to surgery, addressing a specific clinical need to ensure adequate preoperative preparation [^src1]. 

This code is a key component of the database's technical evolution, specifically enabling the calculation of a new quality metric, Indicator 4 [^src1]. The implementation of NAAZ2 aligns with broader methodological adjustments and continuous quality development efforts in Danish acute surgery, which aim to standardize indicators, improve risk adjustment, and refine underlying data sources for better clinical and political decision-making [^src1].
